# Skills Index

Project skills are organized under `.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.

## Available Skills

- `ha-firmware-fix-pass`
- `ha-yaml-integration-edits`
- `host-check-update-safety`
- `install-uninstall-script-maintenance`
- `bats-kcov-test-authoring`
- `release-doc-and-badge-update`

## When to Use

- Use `ha-firmware-fix-pass` for end-to-end lint/test/coverage repair.
- Use `ha-yaml-integration-edits` for Home Assistant YAML integration changes.
- Use `host-check-update-safety` for board-check and update safety logic.
- Use `install-uninstall-script-maintenance` for setup and rollback behavior.
- Use `bats-kcov-test-authoring` for test additions and coverage wiring.
- Use `release-doc-and-badge-update` for release docs and badge sync.
